headline: A Fazenda 18 Nominations Set For Eighth Weekly Elimination Round
metaDescription: Tina Calamba is currently facing the eighth elimination round of A Fazenda 18, while three other contestants compete for the role of Farm Leader.
aiSummaryBullets: Tina Calamba has been placed in the eighth elimination round of the reality series A Fazenda 18.
Contestants Daniel Erthal, Fran Almeida, and Murilo Dias have also been nominated for potential elimination.
The three nominees will participate in the Farmer's Trial to determine who avoids the final public vote alongside Calamba.
aiContextParagraph: A Fazenda 18 is a popular Brazilian reality television competition broadcast by the Record network. In the latest progression of the game, Tina Calamba was assigned to the eighth elimination round, commonly referred to as the roça. Joining her as nominees are contestants Daniel Erthal, Fran Almeida, and Murilo Dias. These three individuals are scheduled to participate in the Prova do Fazendeiro, or Farmer's Trial, on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. This competition provides participants with an opportunity to escape the elimination ballot. Following the outcome of the trial, the two contestants who do not secure the victory will join Calamba in a public vote to determine who remains in the program. The series continues to attract significant viewer attention as participants face recurring challenges to remain in the competition and avoid eviction by the audience.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to high public search interest regarding the show's latest elimination dynamics and ongoing viewer polls.
